development_selection: P1 chosen before fresh calibration/final generation: lowest mean fixed-final validation position RMSE among P0-P4 (three seeds), plus highest mean raw contact F1. This is development selection, not independent evidence for P1.
analytic: Frozen original 60 Hz first-surface analytic response; identical physical admission/response class to the A-only control. The separate subdivision study is not merged into this comparison.
rounding: Symmetric neighborhood, round outward to the next grid cell; require every covered cell valid/passing. Never truncate at bounds or bridge failed/invalid cells. This is a finite-grid claim only.
calibration_rule: On initially failing calibration tasks, maximize proposal coverage among rules with at least ten proposals and empirical any-perturbation failure <=10%; tie smaller gamma; else abstain. Both selectors calibrated against the same five-point execution-error audit. No risk certificate.
verification: One selected center verification in production. Perturbed-edit simulations are separate offline research calls; they never retry or replace a proposal. Shared actual calls and logical per-proposal calls are both reported.
evaluation: All goals, with initially failing repair tasks reported separately. Compare common fixed gamma primarily; fitted gamma secondarily. Conditional risk among proposals, unconditional success with abstentions failing, worst sampled margin, edit magnitude, coverage and boundary errors. Paired parent bootstrap, 2000 draws, seeds kept within parents.
zero_edit: Known original success proves nominal zero minimality only. Tolerant selection still checks the whole neighborhood. Known original failure invalidates zero everywhere, including as a neighbor.
gallery: Analytic, fixed gamma: first initially failing task with tolerant sampled success and nominal perturbation failure. Prefer the first such task with a contact-sequence change at a measured component edge; if none retain first qualifying task and state that only goal/timing association is observed. Also retain first tolerant perturbation failure. This is illustration selection, never model fitting.
presentation: Measured range is a connected successful component of the simulator grid, not a continuous certificate. Contact explanations compare ordered callbacks on adjacent grid positions. Same-order timing differences are associations, never unique causal attribution.
promotion: Research demonstration in the optional Notebook only; existing interactive hint checkpoint and its one-verification flow remain active.
